title: RESECT MRI and intraoperative ultrasound
version_note: Current landing pages and the pinned re-host identify RESECT as DOI 10.11582/2017.00004, while the 2017 dataset article's data-access section cites 10.11582/2016.00003. Three cases were acquired on 2026-09-22 from the MedOtter/RESECT-SEG re-host pinned at e86fb37dd93f7a9c64e48952f71410af59b04b9b; exact selected-file hashes are in the linked sample manifest.
terms_note: Original RESECT images and landmarks are reported as CC BY 4.0. RESECT-SEG masks are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so the combined bounded sample is treated under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Retain both citations and recheck source terms before redistribution.
reference_note: MNI tag files provide paired MRI and ultrasound world coordinates in millimetres. RESECT-SEG tumor masks are separate contextual annotations, not registration ground truth.
access_note: The legacy NIRD landing page was unreliable during acquisition. Raw volumes remain local; the pinned re-host supplied bounded individual files. This record does not establish continuing access.
